verdicts.reason: A keeps the diamond photo mosaic, the address/date diamonds and the headline–rule–copy block exactly as in the original. But it is just the square layout shrunk and centred on a 9:16 canvas, leaving a dead white band of about 95px at the top and a large empty area at the bottom; the body copy and vertical URL are also small. B breaks the mosaic: the white lattice is torn and misregistered, with stray white wedges at the top left and triangle fragments hanging off the bottom of the photo. Its rule line has also come away from the headline and now sits right on top of the body copy, which wrecks the type lockup.
